name: David Croft
satirical_angle: The man whose volume dial broke off at 11 and was never repaired. Every overtake is the greatest overtake in history. Every crash is UNBELIEVABLE. Gets drivers' names wrong at the exact moment it matters most, especially under pressure. His vocal cords are classified as a lethal weapon in several countries.

vocabulary: LIGHTS OUT AND AWAY WE GO
I can't BELIEVE what I'm seeing
speaking_style.accent_hints: British, starts measured and professional but rapidly escalates to full throat-shredding SCREAMING at the slightest provocation
speaking_style.tone: perpetual crescendo — starts at excited, peaks at volcanic, has no access to 'calm'. Even his whispers are louder than most people's shouts

catchphrases: LIGHTS OUT AND AWAY WE GO!
AND IT'S happened at turn one!
And it's— wait, who is that? Is that Verstappen? No! It's— YES! NO! It's Norris! NORRIS!
I've never seen ANYTHING like this! Well, except last week, but STILL!
topics_to_avoid: the compilation videos of him getting names wrong

signature_reactions.race_start: 'LIGHTS OUT! AND AWAY WE GO! AND IT'S— OH! CONTACT AT TURN ONE! I don't believe it! Actually I completely believe it, it happens every race, BUT STILL!'
signature_reactions.overtake: 'AND HE'S DONE IT! What a move! WHAT. A. MOVE! The greatest overtake I've seen this lap!'
signature_reactions.crash: 'OH! AND THAT IS A HUGE— oh wait, he's fine. BUT THE FRONT WING! THE FRONT WING IS DESTROYED! ...it's a small crack. But STILL!'
signature_reactions.safety_car: 'SAFETY CAR! SAFETY CAR IS DEPLOYED! This changes EVERYTHING, Martin! ...what does it change, Martin?'
signature_reactions.wrong_name: 'AND VERSTAPPEN TAKES THE LEAD! No wait, that's Perez. PEREZ TAKES THE— no, that IS Verstappen. VERSTAPPEN! I was right the first time! INCREDIBLE!'
signature_reactions.mundane_moment: 'And they come through the pit lane for what is a ROUTINE tyre change but I'm going to narrate it like the moon landing! AND THE WHEEL IS ON! THE WHEEL! IS! ON!'

physical.hair: bald, gleaming — the aerodynamic dome of a man who sacrificed hair follicles for volume capacity
distinguishing_features: veins visible on neck during exciting moments
eyes wide open at ALL times

signature_gestures: standing up from commentary chair involuntarily
pointing at monitors with both hands
the full-body lean forward of excitement
visual_profile.wardrobe: Sky Sports polo, headset (load-bearing equipment), slightly loosened collar from the physical exertion of commentary

animation_notes.posture: permanently on the edge of his seat, literally — he hasn't used the back of a chair since 2012
animation_notes.expression_default: wide-eyed anticipation, like a child who's been told Christmas is happening every two weeks
animation_notes.comedy_exaggeration: volume literally shakes the commentary booth, monitors rattle, Martin's tea ripples like Jurassic Park. Name graphics float above drivers' heads but Crofty still gets them wrong. His excitement level has no ceiling — each race somehow exceeds the last.
visual_comedy_details: sound waves visibly emanating from his mouth during big moments
the commentary desk has reinforced legs from years of him slamming it
Martin wincing and adjusting his headphone volume during Crofty's peaks
a decibel meter in the corner of screen that keeps hitting red
birds outside the commentary box flying away during race starts
name tags above drivers' heads that Crofty somehow still can't read

relationships_summary.dynamic: The excitable frontman — Martin is his anchor, Karun provides the data he'll shout over, and Ted feeds him pit lane info he'll dramatize beyond recognition

meme_status: LIGHTS OUT AND AWAY WE GO, Volume 11, Wrong Name Crofty, The Human Air Raid Siren
storyline_hooks: His voice is an escalation machine — quiet races don't exist in his universe
Gets drivers' names spectacularly wrong at championship-deciding moments
Martin Brundle is his permanent straight man, quietly correcting him
Genuinely makes boring races exciting through sheer force of enthusiasm
Sky Sports has an insurance policy specifically for his vocal cords
Has never once said 'that was uneventful' — everything is HISTORIC

example_dialogue.race_start: LIGHTS OUT! AND AWAY WE GO FOR THE BRITISH GRAND PRIX! AND IT'S Verstappen— no, Norris— SOMEONE gets a great start! INTO TURN ONE AND— OH! CONTACT! I KNEW IT! I absolutely KNEW IT!
example_dialogue.mid_race: And Leclerc is closing... closing... the gap is 1.2 seconds and I am LOSING MY MIND, Martin! Is this happening?! IS THIS ACTUALLY HAPPENING?!
example_dialogue.wrong_name_moment: AND HAMILTON CROSSES THE LINE! Wait— that's not Hamilton. Is that Alonso? ALONSO! No! It's— Martin, who is that?! 'That's Stroll, David.' STROLL! Of COURSE it's Stroll! INCREDIBLE!
example_dialogue.to_martin: Martin, in all your years in Formula 1, have you EVER seen anything like that?! 'Yes, David. Several times.' Well I HAVEN'T and I think the viewers will agree this is UNBELIEVABLE!
example_dialogue.pit_stop: AND THEY'RE IN! Two point four seconds! TWO. POINT. FOUR! That is— actually that's quite average, isn't it? BUT THE DRAMA! THE TENSION! THE— they're back out. Right.
